movies.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
movies.title: Heart of the Beast

movies.overview: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.
movies.title: Never Surrender

When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

movies.title: Beware Boiúna

Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

movies.overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.
movies.title: The Fix

What begins as revenge turns into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction and lies, drawing her toward a truth she may not be ready to face.
movies.title: Perfect Liars

movies.tagline: I killed my wife and her body disappeared.

movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

Struggling with the weight of becoming the symbol of resistance, she must navigate fragile alliances while trying to protect those she loves. As propaganda battles rage and Panem moves closer to full-scale war, Katniss is forced to confront the true cost of revolution.
movies.tagline: Fire burns brighter in the darkness.
movies.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1

movies.overview: In a dystopian society where the Capitol forces each district to send two young tributes to fight to the death in a televised spectacle, a girl volunteers to take her sister’s place, setting the stage for a struggle of survival and defiance.
movies.title: The Hunger Games

movies.overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.
movies.title: The Social Reckoning

movies.overview: When millions in cartel cocaine go missing off Florida's coast, the search turns savage as vicious sharks close in on anyone daring to claim the stash.
movies.title: Great White Waters

movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
movies.title: Obsession

movies.overview: Will Radford is a top analyst for Homeland Security who tracks potential threats through a mass surveillance program, until one day an attack by an unknown entity leads him to question whether the government is hiding something from him... and from the rest of the world.
movies.title: War of the Worlds

movies.tagline: There is no light where we're going.
movies.title: Verity

movies.title: Drive - The Pretenders

movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further

movies.overview: Over the course of one explosive night, a small-town diner becomes the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past, and a waitress harboring secrets of her own.
movies.title: Best Pancakes in the County

movies.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.
movies.tagline: At the end of the world, no one survives alone.
movies.title: The Dog Stars

movies.overview: Former country music legend Misty Jones returns to Nashville to unravel the truth behind her rising-star niece's disappearance.
movies.tagline: The brightest stars hide the darkest secrets.

movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

movies.tagline: He's training a new generation of law enforcers for a dangerous mission to save the world from ruthless criminals.
movies.title: The Shadow's Edge

movies.title: Memoir of a Murderer

movies.overview: Sita tries to live an honest and truthful life following all religious and social norms of her upbringing while unraveling the true agenda of men around her. In this process, she emerges victorious as a strong and brave woman.
movies.title: Saayavanam

Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
movies.title: How to Rob a Bank

movies.title: Disclosure Day

movies.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
movies.title: Clayface

movies.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.
movies.tagline: The end is where the plotting begins.
movies.title: A Talent for Murder

movies.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.
movies.tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.
movies.title: The Dark Knight

movies.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
movies.tagline: Sometimes you've got to do a terrible thing for the greater good.
movies.title: Wild Horse Nine

movies.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.
movies.title: Runner

movies.overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.
movies.tagline: Act like you own the place.
movies.title: Parasite

movies.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.
movies.title: Collision Course

movies.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
movies.tagline: Are you ready to make television history?
movies.title: Primetime

movies.overview: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.
movies.title: O.M: Operation Mole

movies.overview: In the remote Scottish Highlands, a desperate mother searches for her missing son, finding herself trapped in a twisted struggle for survival.
movies.tagline: A PARENT IS CAPABLE OF UNIMAGINABLE THINGS
movies.title: Savage Prey

movies.overview: After losing his father, Ethan Nichols inherits one of the largest greenhouses in the country, just as the world faces a devastating threat from an approaching asteroid. As society begins to unravel, Ethan grapples with personal betrayal, overwhelming loneliness, and the growing fear that survival may come at the cost of his humanity. Seeking refuge in his family’s bunker, Ethan endures the harsh aftermath of the impact, wrestling with physical injury and emotional despair. When a faint voice crackles over his radio, Ethan discovers he's not as alone as he believed.
movies.title: After Impact

movies.overview: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.
movies.title: Whalefall

movies.overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.
movies.title: The Batman

movies.overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.
movies.title: Fight Club

movies.overview: A "controlled” avalanche blast goes terribly wrong, and environmental officer Martia and her family find themselves trapped under the ice in a crashed cable car. Battling their wounds, the cold, and inner demons, they soon learn that, just as bad as they want out, something wants in.
movies.tagline: Surviving the disaster was only the beginning.
movies.title: Frostbite

movies.overview: A corrupt, troubled cop's night spirals out of control when a reluctant act of mercy toward an injured girl pulls him into a deadly web of crime.
movies.title: Gajab Raat

movies.overview: A grieving mother is haunted by the tragic loss of her daughter in a car accident that left her abusive husband in a coma. As she battles a surreal descent into darkness, her sleepwalking episodes intensify. Plagued by haunting visions of her husband inside their home, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.
movies.tagline: When night falls, every memory can be a nightmare.
movies.title: Sleepwalker

movies.overview: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.
movies.tagline: Some search for battle, others are born into it...
movies.title: One Battle After Another

movies.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.
movies.title: The Awakening
